name: app.designmdpro/designmdpro
title: DesignMD Pro
description: Search curated website design systems and read their DESIGN.md tokens, guidance and revisions.

tools.name: search_websites
tools.description: Search the DesignMD Pro library of website design systems by name, domain, description or category, optionally narrowed to a category and/or design tags. Returns slugs plus a summary (tags, primary color, preview palette, fonts, token counts, Pro/locked status). Pass a slug to get_design_md for the full DESIGN.md. Use list_categories / list_tags to find valid filters.

query.description: Literal keyword to match against name, domain, description or category, e.g. "linear" or "fintech". Omit to list the latest websites.

category.description: Exact category filter (e.g. Developer Tools); see list_categories

tags.description: Design or product tags — matches websites carrying ANY of them (case-insensitive), e.g. ["Dark Mode", "Editorial"]; see list_tags

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the website categories in the DesignMD Pro library with how many design systems each holds, most populated first. Pass a category to search_websites to browse it.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the design and product tags used across the DesignMD Pro library (e.g. "Dark Mode", "Editorial", "Monochrome") with how many websites carry each, most used first. Use it to turn a mood or style brief into tags for search_websites.

query.description: Only tags containing this text (case-insensitive), e.g. "dark"

category.description: Only count websites in this category

tools.name: get_design_md
tools.description: Get a website's DESIGN.md design-system spec by slug. Use `sections` to fetch only the headings you need (response lists availableSections), and format `json` for structured tokens instead of Markdown. `version` selects a historical revision (see list_revisions). Pro sites return prose plus a token preview unless called by a Pro account (OAuth or API key).

sections.description: Section headings to include (case-insensitive, partial match), e.g. ["Colors", "Typography"]

format.description: md (default) = DESIGN.md text; json = structured tokens

tools.name: list_revisions
tools.description: List the revision history of a website's DESIGN.md (newest first): version, date, changelog and token counts. Pass a version to get_design_md to read that revision.

tools.name: extract-color-palette
tools.description: Extract a frequency-ranked, role-classified color palette from a website by statically analyzing its HTML and CSS. Returns ranked colors (hex/rgb/hsl, roles, usage counts), grouped palette roles (primary/accents/neutrals/surfaces/texts), resolved CSS custom properties, and a separate dark-scheme palette when the site ships one.

url.description: Full URL or bare domain of the page to analyze (e.g. https://linear.app or linear.app)

limit.description: Max colors per scheme palette (default 24, max 64)
